_note: These are OUR OWN estimates of manual effort, not measured data. Edit the numbers if your team disagrees, but keep the 'basis' honest. The pitch must call them estimates.

tasks.task: Draft a test package and traceability matrix for one system
tasks.basis: 2-3 working days: read ~25 clauses, write a test per requirement (steps, instruments, acceptance), then build the clause-to-test matrix by hand.

tasks.task: Find everything a spec or delivery change affects
tasks.basis: Search schedule, POs, test list and handover documents by hand for every item linked to the changed equipment, then re-work the dates.

tasks.task: Cross-check all submittals against spec values
tasks.basis: 20 submittals x about 15 minutes each to find the matching clause and compare rating, unit and model.

tasks.task: Compare nameplate photos with the approved submittals
tasks.basis: 10 photos x 3-6 minutes each: read the plate, find the submittal, compare. Manual checks usually happen after installation, so the real saving is catching it earlier.
